paragraphs: Hyman describes a certain man in the days of Rav Ashi who performed acts of sleight of hand (optical illusion); see [Sanhedrin 67b (Hyman cites 67a)](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.67b.14).[^1]

notes.text: In the linked passage Rav Ashi says he saw Karna’s father produce rolls of silk from his nostrils by sleight of hand. The phrase אבוה דקרנא means “Karna’s father.” Hyman retains the form Abba of Karna as the headword.
